comment.text: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before a template from the AI templates catalog is installed; installing creates new rooms and installing again creates them again. A yes/no question ending with a question mark.

usage.context:
displayType={ModalDialogType.modal}
 onClose={isInstalling ? undefined : closeInstallConfirmation}
 dataTestId="ai-template-install-dialog"
 >
 <ModalDialog.Header>
 {t("Common:AiTemplateInstallTitle")}
 </ModalDialog.Header>
 <ModalDialog.Body>
 <Text dataTestId="ai-template-install-description">
 <Description template={template} t={t} />
 </Text>
